title: Container Bookings: Carrier Rolls Awaiting Compensation and Their Order
content:
Which carrier rolls on a Container Bookings booking still await compensation, and whether a given roll qualifies, is decided from the booking's roll notices and compensation entries.

## Rule

The carrier rolls still awaiting compensation number the roll notices on the booking that name the carrier as the cause, less the roll compensation entries on the booking. They are compensated in the order in which they were recorded, with one compensation entry per roll, each entry referring to the roll notice it compensates.

The roll being compensated occupies the position one higher than the number of compensation entries already on the booking. Compensation is due for it provided that position is no higher than the product's number of compensated carrier rolls. When no carrier roll awaits compensation, or when the position exceeds that number, nothing is credited.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** roll notices naming the carrier; roll compensation entries.
- **Judgement:** do the carrier roll notices outnumber the compensation entries? If so, the earliest roll without compensation is next, at the position just above the count of compensation entries; is that position within the product's number of compensated rolls?
- **Output:** the roll notice to be compensated, or none.

## Hypothetical cases (product compensating 2 carrier rolls)

| Carrier roll notices | Compensation entries | Roll next in line | Position | Earns compensation? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | the first roll | 1 | yes |
| 2 | 1 | the second roll | 2 | yes |
| 3 | 2 | the third roll | 3 | no |
| 2 | 2 | none | not applicable | nothing to credit |

The number of compensated rolls used here is an illustrative input.
